author: hlntnr
text:
Adversarial examples in the wild! 😮 Tumblr is introducing a new rule against "adult content", and using an open source model to detect posts that violate the new rule. Predictably, users are finding creative ways to evade the algo.

@goodfellow_ian @nottombrown @catherineols

quoted.text: @ChappellTracker @lagonegirl They're using open_nsfw, a neural network trained to identify nsfww content, which has a layer of two competing nsfw and sfw liking neurons that combine for the final result, so literally including a picture of a landscape with the image can hype up SFW Guy and lower the nsfw %
